name: public-python-code-localization-v1
provenance: Author-constructed code-localization questions, drafted with AI assistance and individually checked against imported fixed-version source, AST definitions and indexed symbols. These are code-understanding questions, not public GitHub Issues, reproduced defects, patches or repair-success evaluations. There was no independent human adjudication or inter-annotator study. All repositories also appear in dev, so test results do not establish repository-level generalization; source-aware question construction and model pretraining contamination may bias results.
notes: This measures localization, not issue resolution or patch correctness.
hash embeddings and hybrid_rerank are lexical baselines; no semantic/reranker-model claim.
Indexing latency is separate; retrieval includes query embedding and excludes answer generation.
No dollar cost estimated without provider pricing; usage tokens are reported when available.
Small public benchmark subsets can be present in model training; contamination cannot be excluded.
